text:
rachel: Quick alert - after I tightened netpols for ns=priv-edge I see outbound TLS to 13.59.77.101 from keystore-proxy. That IP isn't in our allowlist. Anyone oncall?

ops-bot: [ANOMALY] priv-edge cluster egress to 13.59.77.101 detected 2026-06-03T03:46Z. 27 connections from sa:keystore-proxy.

omar: I applied the netpol deny at 03:44:12 UTC and also removed a clusterrolebinding that granted secrets.create to keystore-proxy. Patch command: `kubectl patch clusterrolebinding keystore-crb --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/roleRef/name","value":"keystore-readonly"}]'`

anita: Oncall. Can you run `kubectl get pods -n priv-edge -o wide -l app=keystore-proxy` and `kubectl logs -n priv-edge keystore-proxy-0 --since=10m`? We need kube-audit lines and VPC flow logs.

rachel: Pods: keystore-proxy-0 on node node-07. Logs show repeated attempts to /v1/decrypt at 03:45:05 using the SA token. Snippet:
```n{"user":"system:serviceaccount:priv-edge:keystore-proxy","verb":"get","resource":"decrypt","timestamp":"2026-06-03T03:45:05Z"}
```

dinesh: VPC logs confirm NAT-gw-5 outbound to 13.59.77.101 at 03:45:06. keystore-hostname resolves to kms-legacy-corp.example.net (external). Suggest immediate containment: rotate SA token, patch deployment to use temp-sa with no egress, and add egress deny at VPC for that IP.

clare: I'll prepare the rollback steps for the CRB change and add a runbook note to gate secrets-related RBAC edits with an egress smoke test. Also propose short TTLs for SA tokens.

keystore-bot: [INFO] KMS policy check: 13.59.77.101 not in approved list for priv-edge. Recommend revoke key grants if external.

omar: Executed containment: created sa temp-noegress, patched deployment, deleted old token secret, restarted pod. Applied VPC deny for 13.59.77.101. Monitoring for repeats.

anita: I'll open incident INC-2026-621 and own forensic collection: kube-apiserver audit, node journal, pod fs snapshot, and image scan for baked-in creds. If keys were used externally, loop in legal/compliance.

dinesh: For triage: run `trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL keystore-proxy:stable` and `jq` the audit stream for any impersonation. If app retried cached calls after RBAC change that explains bursts; still need postmortem.

rachel: Thanks team. Adding timeline and artifacts to INC-2026-621. Will follow up with a postmortem and recommended policy changes.
